hotel.name: Pousada de Lisboa - Praça do Comercio

verified_facts.text: Pousada Lisboa is in Praça do Comércio, just a few metres from the River Tagus.
verified_facts.excerpt: Today, Pousada Lisboa, located in the majestic Praça do Comércio, just a few metres from the River Tagus

verified_facts.text: The building was once the residence of kings and headquarters of ministries.
verified_facts.excerpt: It was once the residence of kings and headquarters of ministries.

verified_facts.text: The historic building is over two centuries old, was erected after the 1755 earthquake, housed the former Ministry of Internal Administration, and was converted into a hotel by the Pestana Group in 2015.
verified_facts.excerpt: in a historic building that is over two centuries old, erected after the 1755 earthquake, which housed the former Ministry of Internal Administration before being converted into a hotel by the Pestana Group in 2015

verified_facts.text: The pousada has works of art of historical importance provided by the Lisbon Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: including works of art of historical importance, provided by the Lisbon Museum

verified_facts.text: The Great Hall is the former meeting room of the Council of Ministers, with a gilded ceiling restored in detail and its original chandelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: This is the former meeting room of the Council of Ministers, featuring an impressive, gilded ceiling, restored in detail, and that also retains its imposing chandelier.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have elegant, contemporary and sophisticated decor.
verified_facts.excerpt: which feature an elegant, contemporary and sophisticated decor

verified_facts.text: Molton Brown provides the amenities in all rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: provides the amenities in all rooms, offering guests a distinctive sensory experience

verified_facts.text: Room types range from Cozy to Mezzanine, Superior, Deluxe and Premium, up to the Suite, Suite Áurea, Suite Praça do Comércio and Presidential Suite, some with views of Terreiro do Paço.
verified_facts.excerpt: from Cozy (Queen) to King Classic, Mezzanine, Superior, Deluxe and Premium, up to the King suites (Suite, Suite Áurea, Suite Praça do Comércio and Suite Presidencial), some with views of Terreiro do Paço

verified_facts.text: The pousada has a discreet indoor swimming pool with heated water, open all year round.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Pousada has a discreet indoor swimming pool, with heated water, open all year round

verified_facts.text: The wellness area has an indoor heated pool, sauna, gym and massage room with treatments by appointment.
verified_facts.excerpt: It has a wellness area with an indoor heated pool (8:30 am - 8:00 pm), sauna, gym (8:30 am - 8:00 pm) and massage room with treatments by appointment

verified_facts.text: Massage sessions are available by appointment in the massage room, offering a variety of therapeutic treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Massage sessions are available by appointment, guaranteeing an exclusive and dedicated service.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served in Pátio Amália, a space with a retractable dome, buffet style with more elaborate à la carte options.
verified_facts.excerpt: In that space, with a retractable dome, wonderful breakfasts are served buffet style, and also with more elaborate à la carte options.

verified_facts.text: RIB Lisboa specialises in high-quality meats and wines, with seating inside or on a terrace protected by the arches of Praça do Comércio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose your spot, either in the cosy interior or on the terrace, protected by the arches of Praça do Comércio

verified_facts.text: The nearest metro station is Terreiro do Paço on the Blue Line, next to Praça do Comércio.
verified_facts.excerpt: The nearest metro station is Terreiro do Paço (Blue Line), next to Praça do Comércio.

verified_facts.text: Paid public parking nearby is available to guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, paid public parking nearby is available to guests.

verified_facts.text: The pousada is a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's a 5-star hotel, a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World

verified_facts.text: Praça do Comércio, also known as Terreiro do Paço, was the centre of Portugal's royal and administrative power, with monuments such as the Rua Augusta Arch and the Equestrian Statue of King Joseph I.
verified_facts.excerpt: having been the centre of Portugal’s royal and administrative power, with monuments such as the Rua Augusta Arch and the Equestrian Statue of King Joseph I

verified_facts.text: The gym has fitness machines, free weights and cardiovascular equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Pousada has a gym space, with fitness machines, free weights and cardiovascular equipment
